away.","source_id":"GLUE_NAV","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Think back to that fountain you just left — Bethesda Terrace was the one place Olmsted and Vaux ever wanted a statue, and the angel they got was carved by Emma Stebbins, the first woman ever handed a city commission like it.","source_id":"GLUE_REFLECTION","source_type":"glue","stop_idx":1},{"text":"When the time came to honour John Lennon in this corner of Central Park, Yoko Ono asked for one thing above all — no statue.","source_id":"8fd8fd9a-e256-41fa-9b85-9fc118ff19a6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"She wanted a living memorial instead, because, as the Parks landscape architect Arne Abramowitz recalled, she felt there were already enough statues in the park.","source_id":"8fd8fd9a-e256-41fa-9b85-9fc118ff19a6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The land itself had been named Strawberry Fields in his memory back in April 1981.","source_id":"8fd8fd9a-e256-41fa-9b85-9fc118ff19a6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The name comes from \"Strawberry Fields Forever,\" the song Lennon wrote — and that song, in turn, was named for a children's home called Strawberry Field, which stood near his boyhood home in Liverpool.","source_id":"37d32e91-ace2-4c19-92e9-11ecc71ba5b6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["601070e6-b2e7-4b9b-bb48-047b86e5361c"]},{"text":"Back then the spot was a sorry thing, an isolated median stranded between West Drive and two slip roads off 72nd Street, which is why that August the city announced it would be completely renovated and landscaped.","source_id":"8fd8fd9a-e256-41fa-9b85-9fc118ff19a6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Bruce Kelly, chief landscape architect for the Central Park Conservancy, drew up the design for these 2.5 acres, and construction began in April 1984.","source_id":"7116c807-6e2a-4e06-8322-3c892d953004","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["37d32e91-ace2-4c19-92e9-11ecc71ba5b6"]},{"text":"What Kelly shaped is a tear-shaped garden — a grove of stately elms on a wedge of land that falls away on two sides of the park.","source_id":"51e5d016-f831-45d9-a7b4-a2f68754b78e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["6a12df30-df12-4136-9ded-e88379279af6","fc2f91ec-e9c2-42ad-bc34-25221b4353bd"]},{"text":"It sits right across Central Park West at West 72nd Street from the Dakota, the building where Lennon lived with Ono and was shot dead in 1980.","source_id":"51e5d016-f831-45d9-a7b4-a2f68754b78e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["fc2f91ec-e9c2-42ad-bc34-25221b4353bd","6a12df30-df12-4136-9ded-e88379279af6"]},{"text":"The garden opened on October 9, 1985 — what would have been Lennon's 45th birthday — dedicated by Ono and mayor Ed Koch, with her son Sean, who was turning ten that very same day.","source_id":"7116c807-6e2a-4e06-8322-3c892d953004","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Speaking for the United Nations was Marcela Pérez de Cuéllar, the UN first lady.","source_id":"7116c807-6e2a-4e06-8322-3c892d953004","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"At its heart, a circular path of inlaid black-and-white stones, laid in the Portuguese pavement style, spells out a single word — Imagine, the title of his most famous song.","source_id":"6a12df30-df12-4136-9ded-e88379279af6","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1,"also_cites":["fc2f91ec-e9c2-42ad-bc34-25221b4353bd","51e5d016-f831-45d9-a7b4-a2f68754b78e"]},{"text":"A bronze plaque nearby names the 121 countries that sent trees, plants, and stones to bless the place as a garden of peace.","source_id":"fc2f91ec-e9c2-42ad-bc34-25221b4353bd","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Ono helped pay for all of it, and if you'd like, she narrates an audioguide to the garden herself.","source_id":"51e5d016-f831-45d9-a7b4-a2f68754b78e","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"Every October 9th and December 8th — his birth and his death — thousands still gather, many of them staying late into the night singing his favorite songs.","source_id":"fc2f91ec-e9c2-42ad-bc34-25221b4353bd","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"But no one belonged to this place quite like Gary dos Santos.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"For nineteen years, this Beatles-devoted performance artist knelt on the mosaic and built designs around and inside it — circles of flowers and objects, often shaped into a peace sign.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"The New York Times wrote him up.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"He lived on tips from tourists, drawn in by the flowers and by a three-minute monologue he'd deliver about his work and about the life of Lennon and his family.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"For almost twenty years he came here daily with his girlfriend of fifteen years, Lisa Page, and their dog, Mary Jane, until the long-time locals all knew him by name.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"There's even a documentary about him, The Mayor of Strawberry Fields, directed by Torre Catalano and distributed by Nehst Studios.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1},{"text":"In September 2013 he was diagnosed with leukemia, and after about nine weeks in the hospital, he was gone that November.","source_id":"048a5175-ae53-4b1f-9430-b4d689500256","source_type":"beat","stop_idx":1}]}
